listProjection.kind: all syntactic conditional branches, no predicate assumptions

conditionalArgument.episode: Consecutive eligible highest-building sale/rebuy and unforced Orbs-pop cycles at fixed elapsed time. Leaving this control episode is an exit. No reload, Reset, intervening automatic task, forced shimmer, or mutation of the buff/chain table is silently erased.
conditionalArgument.event: At a qualified sale, draw0 passes the positive aura test. If a chain is active, a pop draw0 at its break test clears it. For the next unchained pop, the largest IID53 draw bypasses anti-repeat removal if that test is evaluated; draw0 in native choose selects index0, Frenzy or Clot. Native gainBuff writes the entry before DOM work. Every further Orbs spawn requires an empty buff table.
conditionalArgument.tailBound: If each eligible cycle returns through these source branches in free-IID phase, P(at least 2k further cycles without exit or a blocking buff) <= (1-2^(-265))^k. This is a mathematical argument over the source projection, not yet a Lean source-refinement theorem.
